title: Arcads ad
blurb: V8 — your seven notes plus a louder opening bed. WITH · AI on ink pills, opaque caption pills, wearing / holding / interacting re-timed to your actual onsets, Pixar and Lego typeset on the rail, the finale cut down to three hard cuts and a fixed word column, and the clipped “over” restored by extending the base cut's last shot 0.1s. Same picture everywhere else.
author: Reviewer
notesHint: Each of your V7 notes, and what changed.

notes.n: 0:05.8 — WITH · AI now sits on ink pills
notes.b: Solid ink blocks with a cream ring behind each word, so it reads over the six playing cards.
Every caption pill is fully opaque and fused into one block, inactive words at 90%. That fixes the thumbnails moment and every other busy background.

notes.n: 1:01.9 — wearing / holding / interacting are on your voice
notes.b: Whisper had “wearing” 0.3s early and “holding” 0.4s late. I measured the three onsets from the waveform and the words now slam on the syllable: 61.05, 61.80, 62.40.

notes.n: 1:14.5 / 1:15.6 — PIXAR and LEGO are on the rail
notes.b: Typeset in the same slot as the other styles, with their clicks. One line for Arcads' team: those are third-party marks in their ad's on-screen text; you asked for them, so they're in.

Was five transitions with blur in three seconds. Now: the wall builds with you in the centre, WITHOUT slams on the wall, one hard cut to the fanged mouth on “insane” (you move to the corner circle under the cut), hard cut back to the wall on “creative”, hard cut to the shatter on “budgets”. The four words build in a fixed column — nothing flies to a corner any more.

That was the base cut itself: the last shot ended five frames before the R decayed. Extended the keep by 0.115s and rebuilt the base (now 1:33.5), so the word finishes and the end card holds a beat longer.

The bed's first 28s are 11 dB hotter (limited, no clipping), easing back to the original build by 34s; the showcase drop is unchanged. A first pass at +6 dB barely registered in the mix. If you'd rather have a different track there than a louder one, say so and I'll generate one.

notes.n: Still your call: the “AI ads” comment chip
notes.b: Mirrors your locked line; only works if the comment automation runs on the account that runs the ad.
